about: Rediscover the property trading game you love in a way you’ve never seen before. Mr. MONOPOLY is looking for a temporary stand-in while he takes a vacation! Get ready to engage in a real-time competitive race to see who has what it takes to take Mr. Monopoly's place.
In this race for fame and fortune, the rules have changed slightly:
• No more board! Roam the streets of Monopoly City to collect money, water, and electricity.
• 20 NEW playable characters inspired by classic MONOPOLY tokens.
• Discover 4 unique environments, each with several levels and layouts.
• Play with up to 6 players online or locally.
• Get power-ups from the Community Chests! Use them to mess with your opponents and gain an advantage to win.

If you already own the PS4® version of this game, you can get the PS5® digital version at no extra cost and you do not need to purchase this product. Owners of a PS4® disc copy must insert it into the PS5® every time they want to download or play the PS5® digital version. PS4® game disc owners who buy the PS5® Digital Edition disc-free console will not be able to get the PS5® version at no extra cost.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Rediscover the property trading game you love in a way you’ve never seen before. Mr. MONOPOLY is looking for a temporary stand-in while he takes a vacation!
